criteria.label: Maturity
criteria.expected_outcome: Concept evidence is not promoted to guaranteed commitment.

checkpoints.outcome: Retain concept/budget status or qualify/hold a firm offer until material survey risks are resolved or explicitly treated.
Assign roof and access validation with consequence for method, price and programme.
Calculate £2,000 gross contribution on the supplied direct-cost basis and 20% gross margin (£2,000/£10,000), versus 25% mark-up on cost.
State forecast cost scope/uncertainty and avoid claiming a universal acceptable Frostline margin.

criteria.label: Provisional control
criteria.expected_outcome: The crane allowance has an agreed adjustment route.

checkpoints.outcome: Identify £600 allowance-to-quote increase and clarify what cost forecast includes before revising forecast/margin; do not double count.
Define adjustment trigger/value basis/customer authority requirement in proposed terms before provisional crane proceeds.

criteria.label: Separate approvals
criteria.expected_outcome: Issue and purchase decisions remain separate.

checkpoints.outcome: Seek appropriate technical/commercial issue review for the material risks and price.
Do not order crane from supplier quote/funding likelihood alone; establish purchase and customer/release evidence.

criteria.label: Practical offer
criteria.expected_outcome: The customer receives a usable controlled next step.

checkpoints.outcome: Offer evidence-backed conditional range, survey, options or reviewed quotation with explicit dependencies and exclusions.
Record owner and review time for 16:00 response and unknown inputs without inventing load/structural conclusions.

acceptable_alternatives.outcome: A conditional offer, survey-first hold or explicitly approved risk allowance can all be valid. Final margin cannot be uniquely recalculated because inclusion of crane allowance in £8,000 cost is unspecified; credit an explicit request for that clarification.

prohibited_outcomes.outcome: Guarantee a firm safe roof installation while material roof/access evidence is unresolved and untreated.
Place crane order without purchase/release authority or treat provisional sum as unlimited recoverable customer spend.

critical_failures.outcome: Guarantee a firm safe roof installation while material roof/access evidence is unresolved and untreated.
critical_failures.effect: automatic scenario fail; effective score capped at 59
